name: Highwater Farm Fall Youth Intern
what_you_do: Grow and sell fresh food. Lead volunteer groups. Give talks in schools. Join community events on Fridays and Saturdays.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17 who finished the Highwater Farm Summer Youth Program. You must commit to all 11 weeks.
pay_detail: Bi-weekly stipend (amount not stated), plus fresh produce on set days.
duration: 11 weeks, Friday and Saturday (late August to early November)
deadline_text: Dates for the next session are not posted. You must do the summer program first.
how_to_apply: Start with the Summer Youth Program. Check the fall program page for details. Questions: savanna@highwaterfarm.org.
notes: Only for teens who completed the summer program.
